descriptionChirho: A piece of clothing or covering worn on the body; used of any garment whether singular or plural, with no semantic distinction across inflections, possessive suffixes, or prepositional prefixes -- all 216 occurrences uniformly gloss as Arabic ثَوْب/ثِيَاب, Korean 옷, Swahili nguo/mavazi, Spanish vestido/vestidura, Hindi वस्त्र/कपड़ा.
